decisive_spans.text: Revealed patchy areas of large atypical lymphoid cells with necrosis

response.rationale: The biopsy findings of "large atypical lymphoid cells with necrosis" directly support Lymphoma (D6) and contradict Inflammatory pseudotumor (D8). The VATS wedge resection findings of "infiltration of lung parenchyma by malignant neoplasm" also strongly support Lymphoma.
